newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks march higher, buoyed by CPI data.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks march higher, buoyed by CPI data.

text.p: Madrid stocks bucked the trend to march higher on Thursday buoyed by positive inflation data. Traders said all eyes now on Friday's repo auction.
The general index rose 2.18 points, 0.45 pct, to 485.11. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares gained 29.10 points, 0.53 pct, to 5,566.65.
"The inflation data has had a clear effect on the market," said one trader. "Losses in other key stock markets have failed to dampen spirits".
Traders said turnover remained high with 98.5 billion pesetas changing hands.
February CPI fell to 2.5 percent year-on-year growth from 2.9 percent in January, opening door to a possible cut in the key money market rate at Friday's repo auction, analysts said.

Trading in Telefonica, Repsol and Endesa shares accounted for 51 percent of the global volume. Telefonica closed 40 pesetas higher at 3,525, while Repsol gained 90 to 5,990. Endesa rose 70 pesetas to 9,250.
Among banks, Banesto gained 3.1 percent, while BBV and Santander rose more than one percent.
